tasks.goal: Build a small Node CLI that converts a Roman numeral from argv into an integer and prints the result; then, as a FINAL SEPARATE PHASE, add package.json and a README with a "Verified invocations" section that records the exact commands you used to confirm it works.

Create three markdown files for a fictional birdwatching guide—overview.md, habitats.md, and field-notes.md—each with an H1 title, at least two ## sections, and each section containing a bulleted or numbered list.
Write a no-dependency Node CLI that accepts one argv string, converts it to kebab-case, prints the transformed text, and exits 1 with a stderr usage message when the argument is missing or empty.

Create README.md with "Overview" and "Usage" headings, CONTRIBUTING.md with "Setup" and "Workflow" headings, and a config.json whose contents are exactly {"project":"lantern","stage":"alpha","retainDays":14}.
